verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a first-party release-notes page that announces model launches such as grok-4.7 on the API. Model lifecycle changes are also covered by dated migration and retirement guides with advance notice and redirect policies. missing for 10: evidence of a sustained entry history or cadence showing the changelog is actively maintained, coverage of non-model API changes (endpoints/parameters) in the notes, a followable feed (RSS/email) for updates, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as `grok-4.7`.
